title: The capture loupe and the editor call the same numbers by the same unit
goal: While you drag a capture region the loupe reads the size in pt. Open the capture and the editor reads that same size as px. One thing, two names. Pick one wording and use it in both places, or show both on the loupe.
notes: CaptureLoupe.readout (PhotonzCore) builds the lines from MeasureUnit.points.suffix (px) and CaptureLoupe.actualSuffix (actual px), so the loupe and the editor's Units row share one spelling. The selection line is logical only; a fourth actual-size line is an open audit question.
acceptance: The loupe selection line and the editor readouts agree on the unit for a logical size, or the loupe shows both logical and device size

log.note: Review before building: the editor's px convention is deliberate (px = logical like CSS, Actual = device) and runs through measurements, the inspector Units row and the spec export; the loupe is the newcomer and Next-only, so it adopts the editor's words rather than the other way round. Showing both units would keep the mismatch alive one line lower; the spec header's @2x idiom annotates logical numbers so it cannot label the device line. No user answer to the capture-loupe audit's coordinates question has arrived, and the task was raised to p2, so this proceeds without one.

Built: CaptureLoupe.readout reads '412, 233 px', '825, 466 actual px' (Retina only), '300 × 200 px', with suffixes built from MeasureUnit so the surfaces cannot drift. Widest line about 116 pt against the panel's 123 pt. Tests first: five readout tests in CaptureLoupeTests; suite green (1288). docs/design/capture.md loupe section updated. Current untouched.

Review after building: px / actual px / px reads cleanly on a three-line panel; the one wart is that the editor's View menu 'Actual Size' means point size while 'Actual' units mean device pixels, a pre-existing editor overload noted in the audit. No screenshot: no Screen Recording grant and no committed offscreen loupe harness. Audit queue/audits/2026-09-02-loupe-units.json.

Next's capture loupe now reads px for the pointer and selection (the editor's logical default) and actual px for the device pixel line, spelled as the editor's Units row spells it; no more pt. CaptureLoupe.readout builds suffixes from MeasureUnit; five readout tests, suite green (1288); docs/design/capture.md updated; Current untouched. Audit queue/audits/2026-09-02-loupe-units.json.
